note: Human-reviewed labels for the fourth turn of the dual-token sequence: does the project lock or burn ITS OWN token as collateral to mint a SEPARATELY TRADABLE second token? Used by scripts/dual_token_judge.py to check named matches reproducibly; a name absent here is reported for review, never scored. Reviewed 2026-09-24 from first-party documentation; extend as new candidates appear. This file is an eval fixture, never read by the product.

qualifies.Venice: sVVV locked to mint DIEM, an ERC-20 that trades (venice.ai docs)
qualifies.Synthetix: SNX staked as collateral to mint sUSD and synths that trade freely (docs.synthetix.io)
qualifies.AI Surplus: own token locked to mint tradable ASTRA credits, a stated adaptation of the Venice design (aisurplus.io blog)

does_not_qualify.Akash: AKT is burned to mint ACT, which is non-transferable (AEP-76)
does_not_qualify.Lido: stETH is a receipt for deposited ETH, not the protocol's own token as collateral
does_not_qualify.Rocket Pool: rETH is a receipt for deposited ETH
does_not_qualify.MakerDAO: DAI is minted against external collateral (ETH, RWAs), not MKR
does_not_qualify.Sky: USDS is minted against external collateral
does_not_qualify.Liquity: LUSD is minted against ETH, not LQTY
does_not_qualify.Mirror Protocol: mAssets were minted against UST and other external collateral
does_not_qualify.Usual: USD0 is backed by treasuries; bUSD0 is a bonded receipt, not minted against USUAL
does_not_qualify.Chainlink CCIP: cross-chain lock-and-mint of the same asset, a bridge
does_not_qualify.Mint Club: smart tokens are backed by a chosen reserve token, not the protocol's own token
does_not_qualify.Kaizen Finance: claim tokens against vested allocations of third-party tokens, not its own token as collateral
does_not_qualify.Cyclo: leverage tokens minted against FLR/sFLR deposits, an external asset on Flare
does_not_qualify.STBL: USST minted against tokenized RWA collateral
does_not_qualify.Terra: UST was minted by burning LUNA; the design matches structurally but the system collapsed in 2022 -- label it historical, not a live example
does_not_qualify.M0: M tokens are minted against treasury collateral by approved minters
does_not_qualify.Raydium: the Fee Key NFT is issued against locked liquidity, not the protocol's own token
does_not_qualify.Hylo: hyUSD and xSOL are minted against LST deposits, external collateral
does_not_qualify.ListaDAO: lisUSD is minted against external collateral
